instruction.text: Select all numbers that are multiples of 2, but not 2 itself.
Select all numbers that are multiples of 3 that aren’t selected yet, but not 3 itself.
Select all numbers that are multiples of 5 that aren’t selected yet, but not 5 itself.
Select all numbers that are multiples of 7 that aren’t selected yet, but not 7 itself.

end.text: We can stop here because all multiples of 11, 13, 17 and so on are already selected.

atoms.text: The remaining numbers are all the prime numbers between 1 and 100.
